builder_plan.scenario: Profiling shows attention computation is a bottleneck in your self-hosted service.
builder_plan.change: Check the supported GPU, tensor shapes, and precision, then replace only the relevant kernel.
builder_plan.baseline: The existing kernel inside the same complete serving pipeline.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Numerical differences, end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory at realistic shapes.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: Replaces dense BF16 attention and its full-precision KV cache with tile-level triage that skips, 4-bit, or 8-bit computes QK tiles, plus a compressed quantized KV cache reused at decode. Costs include an offline per-head calibration and budget allocation pass, a fused custom kernel, and possible quality loss on workloads whose attention patterns do not match the diagonal-boundary policy. Can fail when the two-boundary head representation misses irregular critical interactions, when the fused kernel does not support the deployment stack, or when speedups do not materialize at the short contexts typical of the reader's traffic.
rationale: The method fits a single-GPU inference setting and offers large claimed speedups, but the gains depend on a custom kernel and offline calibration whose benefits must be validated on the reader's specific models, context lengths, and hardware before production adoption.
technique: Mixed-precision sparse attention with compressed KV cache

claims.statement: Replaces dense BF16 attention and its full-precision KV cache with tile-level triage that skips, 4-bit, or 8-bit computes QK tiles, plus a compressed quantized KV cache reused at decode. Costs include an offline per-head calibration and budget allocation pass, a fused custom kernel, and possible quality loss on workloads whose attention patterns do not match the diagonal-boundary policy. Can fail when the two-boundary head representation misses irregular critical interactions, when the fused kernel does not support the deployment stack, or when speedups do not materialize at the short contexts typical of the reader's traffic.
End-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline, with quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks.
